title: Not worth it anymore
text: Update. The Corp box used to be top tier. Now it's a joke. Deadpool Ride was nice, but a Keychain and 1$ filler items. The Venom box was trash. I wouldn't have bought the pop by itself much less the 1 inch Dorbz knock off, a sticker, and a standard Funko t-shirt. I will cancel after the next box, the 10 year anniversary unless it blows me out of the water. UPDATE: 10th anniversary was even worse. NO TSHIRT, a WHIPLASH movie moment???!?!?!?! 2 $0.50 mini figures, and a Pez. What a giant waste of money. I wouldn't pay $10 for the movie moment itself even if it came with the other stuff free. Cancelled.
label: negative
